command:
set -eu
export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 RUST_TEST_THREADS=4
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace
node --test scripts/lib/module-size-ratchet.test.mjs
node scripts/check-test-revert-oracle.mjs --base 02efa507f9 --mutation tests/evidence/c4-10a/behaviour.oracle.patch --test rust/wasm-bindings/src/api/gpu_meshes/c4_10a_tests.rs --mutation tests/evidence/c4-10b/behaviour.oracle.patch --test rust/processing/src/execution_tests.rs --mutation tests/evidence/c4-10b/behaviour.adapters.oracle.patch --test rust/wasm-bindings/src/api/gpu_meshes/batch_tests.rs --mutation tests/evidence/c4-10b/policy.oracle.patch --test rust/processing/src/execution_tests.rs --verify-restored --ci --json
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
pnpm fixtures buildingsmart/column-straight-rectangle-tessellation.ifc
pnpm build --filter=@ifc-lite/renderer... --filter=@ifc-lite/export...
CI=1 BUILD_RETAINED=1 bash scripts/build-wasm.sh
pnpm test:wasm-contract
git diff --exit-code 02efa507f9 -- packages/wasm/pkg/ifc-lite.d.ts packages/wasm/pkg-retained/ifc-lite.d.ts rust/wasm-bindings/src/api/gpu_meshes/batch_parity_expected.json
sha256sum packages/wasm/pkg/ifc-lite_bg.wasm
